Let me use the web_fetch tool directly with the arXiv API URL instead.

```python
import json

# Query arXiv API for multimodal RAG papers
query = 'all:%22multimodal+RAG%22+OR+%28all:%22retrieval+augmented+generation%22+AND+all:%22multimodal%22%29'
url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start=0&max_results=10&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'

result = web_fetch(url, max_chars=20000)
print(result['status'])
print(result['content'][:5000])
```
